description: List the worker templates coder::scaffold-worker creates from: id, name, description, language (node | python) and requires (the compose containers the worker needs, e.g. http). source names where they come from: a local dir, or a cached git clone with ref and revision; warning means the clone could not refresh and is stale. refresh: true re-fetches it now.

refresh.description: Re-fetch the cached git clone now instead of after `code.templates.refresh_secs`. No effect on a local dir.

Language.description: Runtime of a worker template, from the template's own `requires`.

requires.description: Compose containers the worker needs, e.g. `http`.

TemplateSourceInfo.description: Where the templates were read from.

location.description: The templates directory (`dir`) or the clone URL (`git`).

ref.description: Branch or tag of the clone (`git` only).

revision.description: Commit the clone is at (`git` only).

warning.description: Set when the clone could not be refreshed and a stale copy is served.

source.description: Where the templates were read from.
